target.statement: GPT-5.4 thinking achieves 26.5% strict all-rubric task pass rate (Overall) on the 102-task MMCL-Bench.
target.table_ref: Table 2, Overall column for GPT-5.4 thinking

compute.basis: The paper reports about 2–3 hours of API execution per model over 102 tasks using 8 workers (App. A.7), but no benchmark assets or code are linked, and the target requires the closed GPT-5.4 thinking API.

blockers: Benchmark code and task assets are not released; the paper only says a future public release will include a license summary
Target requires closed-source GPT-5.4 thinking API access
Evaluation depends on rubric files and an LLM-as-judge protocol, which are not available
The benchmark has 102 multimodal tasks spanning images, manuals, screenshots, videos, and frame sequences, making independent reconstruction of the exact number infeasible
title: MMCL-Bench: Multimodal Context Learning from Visual Rules, Procedures, and Evidence
